description: HubSpot collect pixel on track.hubspot.com/__ptq.gif, whose Hub ID rides as a. The embed loader is vendor/hubspot.

params.name: a
params.description: It is the numeric HubSpot Hub ID. HubSpot tells you to look for `__ptq.gif` and documents `_hsq`, not this query, so the rule is ecosystem evidence.
params.fix_hint: Keep `a` from the generated tracking pixel so it carries the Hub ID.
